text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Victory... Well, it's only the natural 
outcome.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, oh brother. Aren't you a cute 
little puppy? Wagging your tail a bit too 
much there.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"I'm in a good mood right now! Care for a 
reward yourself? Hmm?"
choice_data_list: I want you to win next time too.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ha, you've got no ambition. If you don't 
live more greedily, you're missing out on 
life, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'll stack up as many victories as it 
takes. So—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You'll be a good girl and wait, won't you, 
little puppy?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Fine by me. I'll let you savor it until 
you're sick of it. The taste of victory, 
that is.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Trust your master and be a good boy while 
waiting, alright, puppy?
